predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: the French colonies of Senegal and the Sudanese Republic (French Sudan), joined as the Mali Federation, 'a territory with self-rule within the French Community' from 4 April 1959

ledger.x: 1960: the seat of government moves from Dakar to Bamako.
20 June 1960: the Mali Federation of Senegal and the Sudanese Republic becomes independent from France.
25 December 1985: Mali and Burkina Faso fight over the Agacher Strip.
22 December 1986: the ICJ ends the Agacher dispute.
22 December 1986: Mali receives the western part of the Agacher Strip.
March 2012: the Tuareg rebels take Kidal and Gao.
6 April 2012: the rebels declare Azawad independent.
6 April 2012: Azawad secedes in the north.
February 2013: Malian and French forces retake most of the north.

wars.name: Agacher Strip War
wars.outcome: Ceasefire on 30 December 1985 after five days (25-30 December); the ICJ divided the strip on 22 December 1986, Mali taking the more densely populated western portion and Burkina Faso the eastern section around the Beli.

wars.name: Azawad rebellion and Operation Serval
wars.outcome: The MNLA declared Azawad independent on 6 April 2012 and lost its towns to Islamist groups by 12 July 2012; French forces intervened on 11 January 2013 and with Malian forces 'partially recaptured the north' a month later; the MNLA renounced independence on…
